info.title: ProjectRIMS API
info.description: FastAPI backend for ProjectRIMS CRUD app

post.description:
Authenticate user with email and password.

Returns a JWT access token and user information.

get.description:
List all parts with optional filtering.

status_filter options: active, inactive, in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock

put.description: Update a part (soft-delete check: only if no transactions exist).

get.description: Get movement history for a part.

schema.title: Response Get Part Movements Parts  Part Id  Movements Get

get.description:
List all receivings with optional filtering.

status_filter options: draft, completed, cancelled
pending_gr=true to get receivings awaiting GR confirmation

post.description: Create a new receiving in draft status.

put.description:
Complete a receiving (draft → completed).

Creates PartMovements for all items and updates part stock.

get.description:
List all outgoings with optional filtering.

status_filter options: draft, completed, cancelled
pending_gi=true to get outgoings awaiting GI confirmation

post.description: Create a new outgoing in draft status.

put.description:
Complete an outgoing (draft → completed).

Validates sufficient stock, creates PartMovements, and updates part stock.

get.description:
List all requests with optional filtering.

status_filter options: draft, completed, cancelled

post.description: Create a new request in draft status.
